title: 第203章 阴灵长河恐怖的修炼速度第202章 玄阴控水诀来访
content_zh:
观月崖上，顾景元与两人相谈甚欢。
顾景元丝毫没有仗着天赋好而居高临下，这一态度让两人放心下来。
两人也主动讲解了宗门内的一些禁忌、各峰势力及弟子恩怨等。
半个时辰后，顾景元笑着送走赖炜和赖清欢，然后返回洞府之中修炼。
五天后，他将玄阴控水诀中的几个法术练至入门。
有这几个法术遮掩功法，顾景元也是不担心功法暴露了。
他走出洞府，激活守护大阵，御剑而去。
目的地自然是阴灵长河！
阴墨给了他两千贡献点，足够他修炼两个月了。
御剑大半个时辰，顺利抵达阴河殿。
阴河殿是专门管理阴灵长河的地方，有专门的长老在此坐镇登记。
此刻来来往往，有不少人。
“哎，外门大比还有几年就要开始了，我那弟弟也不知道能不能杀出重围。”
“能晋升内门弟子，也得有个好去处。如今六大主峰，御魂峰和奴心峰好进一些，可论实力也是垫底的。”
“哎，说到这，通幽峰的蒋青峰和镇狱峰的韩拓两人的约战好像快到了吧？”
“我记得应该也就几年了，外门大比之前吧。韩拓据说前段时间已经突破筑基九层了，蒋青峰应该不是对手了。”
“也难说，蒋青峰强在神魂一道，防不胜防，未必没机会。”
“听说了吗，奴心峰的那位大师兄，收了一位弟子。”
“据说还是一个中等灵体，奴心峰最近突破了一个金丹修士，如今又得一个灵体，听说阴墨也闭关了，奴心峰怕不是要崛起了？”
“哪有这么容易？修仙一途，最不缺的就是天才，等他成长起来再说吧。如今六大主峰，奴心峰是最弱的。”

“.....”
听着众人交谈，顾景元默默记下一些，随即走入殿中，来到登记处前，将自己的身份令牌递了过去，恭敬道：“见过长老，弟子要进入阴灵长河修炼。”
长老将令牌接过，神识一扫，下一刻有些诧异地看向顾景元，不由得开口问道：“你便是奴心峰新收的核心弟子？”
这话一出，周围不少人看了过来，各种目光，有质疑，有好奇，有不屑等等。
顾景元没有理会这些目光，只是淡淡点头：“正是弟子。”
长老点头，继续道：“规矩都知道吧？筑基初期，三十贡献点一天，你是核心弟子，也就没有时间限制，只要贡献点足够，便可一直在这边修炼。但要谨记，不能靠近阴灵长河三十丈之内，里面的灵药宝物也不能取，同时不能交手，否则重罚。”
顾景元点头：“是，弟子知晓。”
长老：“去吧。”
顾景元收起令牌，拱手来到前方的一座巨门前，随着令牌拿出，阵法打开，顾景元踏入其中。
光芒一闪，顾景元还未看清，便感到一股粘稠、阴寒、直透骨髓的湿冷之气扑面而来，伴随着鬼魂齐喑般的低沉嗡鸣与水流在无数狭窄孔窍中穿行的呜咽。
顾景元身形微晃，脚下是一块玄黑色石质平台。
抬眼望去，秘境之内昏暗，远处是巨大裂隙，里面是近乎墨黑的流动河水。
content_en:
On Guanyue Cliff, Gu Jingyuan had a very happy conversation with the two of them.
Gu Jingyuan was not condescending at all just because of his talent, and this attitude reassured the two of them.
The two also took the initiative to explain some taboos within the sect, the forces of various peaks, and the grievances and grievances of the disciples.
Half an hour later, Gu Jingyuan sent Lai Wei and Lai Qinghuan away with a smile, and then returned to the cave to practice.
Five days later, he practiced several spells in Xuanyin Water Control Technique to the basic level.
With these spells covering up his skills, Gu Jingyuan is not worried about his skills being exposed.
He walked out of the cave, activated the protective formation, and left with his sword.
The destination is naturally the Yinling River!
Yin Mo gave him two thousand contribution points, enough for him to practice for two months.
Yu Jian arrived at Yinhe Palace successfully after more than half an hour.
The Yin River Hall is a place dedicated to managing the Yin Ling River, and there are special elders who sit here to register.
There were quite a few people coming and going at the moment.
"Hey, the outer sect competition will start in a few years, and I don't know if my brother can break out of the siege."
"To be promoted to an inner disciple, one must have a good place to go. Now among the six main peaks, Yuhun Peak and Slave Heart Peak are easier to advance to, but they are also at the bottom in terms of strength."
"Hey, speaking of this, it seems that the battle between Jiang Qingfeng from Tongyou Peak and Han Tuo from Prison Suppression Peak is coming soon, right?"
"I remember it was only a few years ago, before the Outer Sect Competition. It was said that Han Tuo had broken through the ninth level of foundation building some time ago, and Jiang Qingfeng should be no match for him."
"It's hard to say that Jiang Qingfeng is so strong with his soul that he is hard to guard against, so he may not have a chance."
"Have you heard that the senior brother from Nu Xin Peak has accepted a disciple?"
"It is said that it is still a medium spirit body. Nu Xinfeng recently broke through a golden elixir monk, and now he has obtained another spirit body. I heard that Yin Mo has also gone into seclusion. Is Nu Xinfeng about to rise?"
"How can it be so easy? The most indispensable thing in cultivating immortality is genius. Let's wait until he grows up. Now among the six main peaks, Slave Heart Peak is the weakest."
"..."
Listening to everyone's conversation, Gu Jingyuan silently wrote down some, then walked into the palace, came to the registration office, handed over his identity token, and said respectfully: "I have met the elder, and the disciple wants to enter the Yinling River to practice."
The elder took the token and scanned it with his consciousness. The next moment he looked at Gu Jingyuan in surprise and couldn't help but ask: "Are you the new core disciple of Nu Xin Peak?"
As soon as he said this, many people around him looked over, with various looks ranging from questioning, curiosity, disdain, etc.
Gu Jingyuan ignored these glances and just nodded lightly: "It's the disciple."
The elder nodded and continued: "You know the rules, right? In the early stage of foundation building, you can contribute 30 points a day. You are a core disciple, so there is no time limit. As long as you contribute enough points, you can continue to practice here. But remember, you cannot get within 30 feet of the Yinling River, and you cannot take the elixirs and treasures inside. At the same time, you cannot fight, otherwise you will be severely punished."
Gu Jingyuan nodded: "Yes, disciple knows."
Elder: "Go."
Gu Jingyuan put away the token and walked to a giant door in front of him. As the token was taken out, the formation opened and Gu Jingyuan stepped into it.
As soon as the light flashed, before Gu Jingyuan could see clearly, he felt a thick, cold, clammy air that penetrated the bone marrow, rushing towards his face, accompanied by a low humming like a ghost and the whimpering of water flowing through countless narrow orifices.
Gu Jingyuan's figure was slightly swaying, and there was a black stone platform under his feet.
Looking up, the secret realm was dark, with a huge crack in the distance, and inside was an almost ink-black flowing river.
